stem_book: A monoatomic ideal gas of two moles is taken through a reversible cyclic process starting from A as shown in the V–T figure (A → B straight line through the origin, i.e. isobaric; B → C at T_B (isothermal) up to V_D; C → D at V_D (isochoric) back to T_A; D → A at T_A (isothermal)). The volume ratios are V_B/V_A = 2 and V_D/V_A = 4. If the temperature T_A at A is 27°C, calculate (a) the temperature of the gas at point B, (b) heat absorbed or released by the gas in each process, (c) the total work done by the gas during the complete cycle. (Take R = 2 cal K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.)
